# Bee by HEOSSI

Use `bee/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "bee-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "bee/bee-brood",
});
```
